description: **Generated validators no longer call the constraint vocabulary "phase-2", and the generated-code format moves to 2.** The doc comment on `ValidateBytesWithEvidence` now reads "evidence for the constraint vocabulary". Because the emitted code changed, `strictspec check` reports every committed validator as stale after upgrading: regenerate each one with `strictspec gen`, and raise your `github.com/stricttools/strictspec/go` requirement to this release, since a format-2 validator refuses an older runtime at init. Validators generated at format 1 keep working against this runtime.
